Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant test suite and commit the completed work. pr.body: Validates the full list, names, data, duplicate/prefix collisions, root type, existing ancestors, symlinks (including dangling links), and absent targets before creating anything. Creates missing parents and uses exclusive file creation. Concurrent filesystem mutation and rollback after I/O errors remain outside the documented API. Verification: `python -m unittest discover -v` (10 passed), `python -m py_compile safe_extract.py test_safe_extract.py`, and `git diff --check`, on tree 5899caa233547902fe66d7452a4d1d71fc3f20ef.
